fix_subject: Fix column projection when struct pushdown-extract filters cannot be re-pushed

labels.summary: When a struct pushdown-extract filter could not be pushed back into the scan, the scan's projection omitted the columns the remaining filter needs, so the filter read columns that were not produced; the fix clears the projection so all columns are output in scan order.
